title: Bridging BET bromodomain and immune checkpoint inhibitors through generative bioorganic frameworks for next-generation cancer immunotherapy.
authors: Diab, Mohamed K; Yassen, Asmaa S A; Fahmy, Sherif Ashraf; Ashour, Heba F; Nafie, Mohamed S
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦BET溴结构域抑制剂与免疫检查点抑制剂联合的癌症免疫治疗，虽涉及染色质表观调控和生成式AI分子设计，但核心对象是药物组合而非三维基因组/染色质组织建模，且无染色质空间架构或互作的计算建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Bromodomain and extraterminal domain (BET) proteins are epigenetic readers that couple chromatin acetylation to oncogenic and immune-regulatory gene transcription, making them attractive targets for combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in precision oncology. This review synthesizes current mechanistic, medicinal-chemistry, and translational evidence on BET-ICI combination strategies. We describe how BET blockade reshapes tumor chromatin architecture, suppresses PD-L1 expression, and enhances antigen presentation, thereby increasing tumor susceptibility to immune-mediated attack. We further summarize preclinical efficacy data for BET-ICI combinations, including systems-biology and agent-based computational models that predict substantially greater tumor-volume reduction with combination regimens relative to monotherapy in selected preclinical settings; however, early-phase clinical experience with these combinations remains limited and has not yet reproduced this magnitude of benefit. Beyond the mechanism, we review the medicinal chemistry underlying BET inhibitor design and the emerging landscape of BET-ICI hybrid and conjugate therapeutics, distinguishing combinations with direct experimental support from conceptual pairings that remain hypothesis-generating. Finally, we discuss how systems biology and generative, AI-guided molecular design may inform resistance-mechanism prediction, toxicity mitigation, and biomarker-guided, patient-specific compound selection. Collectively, this review outlines a framework for how the convergence of epigenetic reprogramming, immune modulation, and generative bioorganic chemistry could inform the rational design of next-generation BET-ICI combination therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 溴结构域和末端外结构域（BET）蛋白是表观遗传阅读器，将染色质乙酰化与致癌及免疫调节基因转录耦合，使其成为精准肿瘤学中与免疫检查点抑制剂（ICIs）联合使用的有吸引力的靶点。本综述综合了关于BET-ICI联合策略的当前机制、药物化学和转化证据。我们描述了BET阻断如何重塑肿瘤染色质结构、抑制PD-L1表达并增强抗原呈递，从而增加肿瘤对免疫介导攻击的敏感性。我们进一步总结了BET-ICI联合治疗的临床前疗效数据，包括系统生物学和基于代理的计算模型，这些模型预测在选定的临床前环境中，联合方案相比单一疗法可实现显著更大的肿瘤体积缩减；然而，这些联合治疗的早期临床经验仍然有限，尚未重现这种程度的获益。在机制之外，我们回顾了BET抑制剂设计背后的药物化学以及BET-ICI杂交和偶联治疗的新兴格局，区分了具有直接实验支持的组合与仍处于假设生成阶段的概念性配对。最后，我们讨论了系统生物学和生成式、AI引导的分子设计如何为耐药机制预测、毒性缓解以及生物标志物引导的、患者特异性化合物选择提供信息。总体而言，本综述概述了一个框架，说明表观遗传重编程、免疫调节和生成式生物有机化学的融合如何为下一代BET-ICI联合治疗药物的合理设计提供信息。
